descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Denmark puts you in the captain's seat over the real Copenhagen, the Oresund and Malmo.

THE REAL COPENHAGEN
City Hall's tower, Christiansborg Palace, the Round Tower, Rosenborg, the Black Diamond, Nyhavn, the Opera, Amalienborg, the Marble Church, the Little Mermaid, CopenHill and Tivoli.

THE ORESUND
The Oresund bridge to Sweden with trains on its lower deck and cars on top, Saltholm, the island of Ven, Malmo and the Turning Torso, Kronborg Castle at Helsingor.

A LIVING CITY
Trains on their real tracks, traffic on the real roads, yachts and ships on the Sound. At night the city and the bridge light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar, the city's spires through the doors. Repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
Kastrup approaches over the city and the Oresund, a sunset hop to Sweden, the Harbour Run, around the Turning Torso, Kronborg and the Sound, a Roskilde scramble, Copenhagen by night, a city tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.

English and Danish menus.
